plugin_description: Drop-in Tizen widget for Samsung Smart TV. Put the JAR in plugins/ — no server changes required.
settings.title: Samsung TV Widget
settings.description: Standalone plugin: it publishes a Tizen widget into the web static root. Set the LAN address of this server so the TV can open Avalon. Install the .wgt, add the Widget URL in URL Launcher, or point Media Station X at msx/start.json.
settings.public_url: Public server URL for the TV
settings.install_steps: 1) Enable Developer Mode on the TV (Apps → 1-2-3-4-5). 2) Install the .wgt via Tizen Studio / sdb, or add the Widget URL in URL Launcher. 3) Optional: point Media Station X to msx/start.json.
